components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on light grounds and on cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: var(--brand-green, #0D492C); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-hanken-grotesk, "Hanken Grotesk"), sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-green, #0D492C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A second action next to a primary button, as a green outline pill.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The site search: a white pill with a round green submit button.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 32rem; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(13, 73, 44, 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 20px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--brand-green, #0D492C); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(13, 73, 44, 0.2); } .ds-search-icon { color: rgba(13, 73, 44, 0.5); display: flex; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-hanken-grotesk, "Hanken Grotesk"), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--brand-green, #0D492C); padding: 8px 0; outline: none; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: rgba(13, 73, 44, 0.75); } .ds-search-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--brand-green, #0D492C); color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-search-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-search-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-green, #0D492C); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-search-btn:hover { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site looks like a good news site printed on warm paper. Most of each page is neutral: a warm paper ground, white cards with a hairline border, and ink text. A few full brand-colour panels anchor the page and mark its main parts. Small saturated accents (card strips, type pills, dots) tie the palette together. The character comes from the details: condensed Bonbance headings in brand green, real photos, and a recognisable palette. It never comes from loud blocks or decoration.

The owner settled this direction on 2026-11-03 after three rounds of feedback. All-saturated cards were "a bit much". Shapes everywhere felt "childish and gimmicky". An all-white page was "ugly, barely any contrast". The Warm Broadsheet is the balance between these three failures. Later the same day, the owner also removed a "How we work" self-description panel as "AI slop".

The density is medium and content first. The homepage has no hero. A compact green intro panel holds the promise, the search and quick-switch chips, and the news follows directly.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with white cards. Depth comes from contrast and hairlines, not from shadows.
Bonbance headings in sentence case, at modest sizes, in brand green.
A few full-colour anchor panels per page. Two adjacent panels never share a colour.
Bold colour as small accents only: a 6px card strip, type pills, dots, region badges, the logo's ".eu".
Full pill shapes for every button, chip and input.
Real photos and screenshots, never illustration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Few Panels Rule
rules.body: Full brand colour fills only the anchor panels: the homepage intro (green), the guides panel (sky), the featured tool (its own tool surface colour), and the newsletter (sage). Two adjacent panels never share a colour.

rules.name: The Accent Not Ground Rule
rules.body: Outside the anchor panels, saturated colour appears only in small elements. A grid of saturated cards is not allowed on the website.

rules.name: The Text-on-Colour Rule
rules.body: Forest green, navy and red take white text. Marigold, sky, sage, rose and cream take ink or forest green. Orange takes ink for body text, because white on orange is only 3.8:1. Never fade text with opacity to make a pair work.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Bonbance headings are always in sentence case. Uppercase is only for small Hanken labels: pills, badges, navigation items and meta lines.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Anton Rule
rules.body: Anton appears in the logo and nowhere else.

rules.name: The No Filler Rule
rules.body: A heading has no subtitle line under it and no eyebrow label above it. If a heading needs a sentence of explanation, rewrite the heading.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A card shows its edge with a hairline and its colour with the top strip, never with a shadow.

rules.name: The Tone-on-Tone Rule
rules.body: A decorative shape is always the same colour family as its panel and is barely visible. Shapes never appear on white surfaces or on cards.

dos: Do put white cards (#ffffff, 1px hairline, 24px radius) on the warm paper ground (#f1eee8).
Do give each card one 6px saturated strip across its top, from the 8-colour rotation.
Do write Bonbance headings in sentence case: forest green on light grounds, marigold on the green panel.
Do make every button, chip, input and badge a full pill, with a visible focus outline in place of the default ring.
Do keep decorative shapes tone-on-tone inside colour panels, at 8 to 12% opacity, with motion off under reduced motion.
Do show real, openly licensed photos on news articles, with the credit under the image.
donts: Don't fill a grid with saturated cards. The owner called that "a bit much".
Don't put shapes or blob illustrations on white surfaces or on cards. The owner called that "childish and gimmicky".
Don't make a page all white with no colour panels. The owner called that "ugly, barely any contrast".
Don't add self-description panels such as "How we work" or "Why trust us". The owner removed one as "AI slop".
Don't add reassurance lines about our own process, such as "Prices and facts checked on …". The owner calls these "AI slop" too.
Don't put shapes, stickers or labels over screenshots. A recommendation is a soft green pill in the content.
Don't use uppercase Bonbance headings, or Anton outside the logo.
Don't put a subtitle under a heading or an eyebrow label above it.
Don't put two panels of the same colour next to each other.
Don't use square or slightly rounded buttons.
Don't add dark mode or `dark:` classes. The site is light only.
